verdict.rationale: Twenty's workflow engine can include a 'Send email' action alongside branches, delays, and iterators (twenty-docs-13, twenty-docs-42), which could technically be chained into a multi-step sequence, and email/calendar sync links messages to CRM records (twenty-docs-4, twenty-docs-52, twenty-docs-58). However, there is no documented dedicated email-template library, cadence/sequence builder, open/click tracking, or reply-handling logic built for prospect outreach - this is a generic automation primitive repurposed for the use case, not a purpose-built sales-sequence tool. missing for 10: dedicated email template management, native multi-step sequence/cadence builder, open/click/reply tracking, and evidence of ops users actually using workflows this way
